key_points: Reports suggest Trump administration may scrap subsidies on certain Medicare plans, potentially hurting UNH's Medicare Advantage business.
Motley Fool and Yahoo Finance pieces are generic pre‑earnings speculation with no new information.
StockTwits notes UNH reached a 52‑week high, indicating recent price strength despite policy concerns.
Seeking Alpha article recommends buying UNH on a recovery thesis, offering a bullish counter‑view.
Employer health cost surge could shift demand toward individual coverage, offering a modest offset to Medicare pressure.
